description: RAG golden set: 20 questions over the seeded demo account (database/seeders/DemoContactsSeeder.php). Each has a reference answer written from the notes, and the notes that hold the answer (identified by contact and a snippet of the note text). 'by' is how the question finds its notes: 'name' (the question names the contact) or 'topic' (it doesn't, so only search can find them).

questions.question: What budget did Juan Dela Cruz give for his condo?
questions.reference: Juan Dela Cruz is a first-time buyer looking for a 1BR condo in BGC with a budget of up to 6.5M, and wants to move in by June next year.

questions.question: Why was Juan Dela Cruz unsure about the Uptown BGC unit?
questions.reference: He liked the layout but thought the monthly dues of about 6,800 were too high. I promised to send him two cheaper options with lower dues.

questions.question: Which bank contact can pre-qualify my buyers quickly, and what does he need?
questions.reference: Juan Miguel Cruz, a home loan officer at Pacific Union Bank, can pre-qualify buyers within 48 hours if sent the client's latest payslips and ITR. His bank offers 6.5% fixed for 3 years with a payroll account.

questions.question: How many people is Andrea Villanueva relocating, and what is their budget?
questions.reference: Andrea's company is relocating 8 team leads from Cebu to Makati in January and wants furnished studios at around 25k a month each.

questions.question: Who decides on Andrea Villanueva's company leases, and when?
questions.reference: Their CFO, Mr. Ramos, decides by the end of the month. The leases are for one year, the company pays the 2-month deposit, and units must be within a 15-minute walk of Ayala Avenue.

questions.question: What yield did the ROI sheet I sent Raffy Mendoza show?
questions.reference: The ROI sheet showed a 5.8% gross yield on the Kapitolyo project. He will decide after talking to his wife Liza, and prefers Viber over email.

questions.question: What does Liza Mendoza want before agreeing to the Airbnb units?
questions.reference: Liza wants the developer's track record and the actual turnover dates of their last three projects.

questions.question: Which client has bad knees, and what kind of unit does she need?
questions.reference: Grace Tan, a retired teacher, has bad knees, so she needs a low floor or a unit close to the elevator. She wants a 2BR in Makati near her daughter.

questions.question: Why hasn't Grace Tan bought a unit yet?
questions.reference: Grace will only buy after her house, appraised at 14M, is sold; she does not want a bridging loan. The buyer of her house is still waiting for loan approval.

questions.question: Which partner gives my clients a discount on interior fit-outs?
questions.reference: Mark Reyes, an architect whose firm does condo interior fit-outs, gives my clients a 10% discount. We already signed a referral agreement.

questions.question: What kind of loan does Sophia Lim want?
questions.reference: Sophia wants a Pag-IBIG loan with a 20-year term. She needs a Special Power of Attorney so her father can sign for her.

questions.question: What office space is Carlo Bautista looking for?
questions.reference: Carlo needs about 80 sqm of office space in BGC or Rockwell for his 12-person startup, with the lease starting in March and a budget of 90k a month.

questions.question: Which client is expecting a baby, and what are they looking for?
questions.reference: Patricia Gomez and her husband Miguel, whose first baby is due in March, want a ready-for-occupancy 2BR in Pasig near a good school and a hospital, budget 8M.

questions.question: Who wanted a pet-friendly place?
questions.reference: Kenji Watanabe wants a pet-friendly 3-bedroom unit in Rockwell or Salcedo Village on a 2-year lease, because his family has a small dog.

questions.question: What is Kenji Watanabe's housing allowance?
questions.reference: Kenji's housing allowance is 180k a month including association dues, and the building must have a gym and a pool.

questions.question: What offers has Lorna Aquino's listing received?
questions.reference: Two inquiries so far; one buyer offered 4.7M and Lorna rejected it. She will only consider offers above 5M.

questions.question: What kind of lot is Daniel Flores looking for?
questions.reference: Daniel wants a 2,000 to 3,000 sqm industrial lot in Laguna or Batangas for a warehouse, cash around 30M, within 5 km of an expressway exit; the Calamba lot was too far from SLEX.

questions.question: How much can Hannah Ramirez afford each month?
questions.reference: Hannah can afford around 15k a month. Rent-to-own in Makati is rare at that budget, so I suggested studios in Pasay or Parañaque.

questions.question: What did I promise Elena Castillo?
questions.reference: I promised to send Elena the outline and a sign-up form for the home-buying seminar on November 20 at 2 PM.

questions.question: Which client needs an estate settlement before selling, and who did I refer him to?
questions.reference: Roberto Garcia inherited a house and lot in Lipa, Batangas, still titled to his late father, so the siblings need an extrajudicial settlement first. I referred him to Atty. De Leon.
